body: # Calendar. ## How to use the Earnings Calendar? TradingView’s Earnings Calendar shows the latest and upcoming earnings reports released by companies. As an important indicator of a company’s financial state, earnings per share are one of the most followed metrics among traders, so the calendar above can serve as a powerful tool for analysis. All reports are sorted in chronological order, from the oldest ones on top to the newest or future values on the bottom. The calendar is simple but contains all the necessary information — the report’s time and company name, estimated and actual EPS, surprise, and the company’s market capitalization. With buttons on the upper panel, you can customize the calendar — choose a time period, country, and time zone to see only those reports that suit your strategy. This way, you can decide to see only the earnings of US companies or track reports globally. You can follow companies' earnings in more detail on corresponding symbol pages. Track Tesla's earnings, Amazon's earnings, and even more.

# Earnings. *Date* - provides the date when the company reported or is expected to report. If the next report date is not available it is derived from our provider's algorithms based on a company's historical reporting dates. It appears only when a full report is available and it can differ from the *As reported*. *As reported* - is the EPS collected directly from a company’s press release for the corresponding period. In the *Reported* field, the value can be either GAAP or non-GAAP, depending on what the majority of brokers report for the specific metric. *Estimate* - the estimated value of the *As reported* EPS derived from data collected by research analysts. The *Estimate* and *As**reported* EPS are typically compared to gauge whether an earnings report beat or missed expectations. They can be different from the *Standardized*number which is a fully-diluted GAAP EPS. The *Estimate* is provided by research analysts and the *As reported* is provided by the company in their earnings press release.
